Behind her is a white brick wall and a grey sofa with a yellow dinosaur plush. She smiles and gestures with her hands while showing the phone's screen. (2) The scene cuts to a top-down close-up on a wooden table where the host's hands are comparing the thinness of two phones. One is the blue foldable device, and she points to the side profile, showing the USB-C port and the SIM tray. The lighting is bright and highlights the metallic finish of the phone. (3) The host appears again, holding two phones side-by-side: a blue Galaxy Z Fold7 and a grey Galaxy S24 Ultra. She moves them slightly to show their back panels and camera modules. Her expression remains highly animated as she speaks directly to the camera lens. (4) A close-up shot shows the unfolded large screen of the phone displaying a photo of two women. The host's fingers are visible at the edges of the device. The background is a blurred living room setting with warm, soft indoor lighting. (5) The final phase shows the host holding the phone with a portrait on it, pointing toward the camera. Yellow and green text overlays appear frequently. She maintains a friendly, high-energy facial expression and ends with a call-to-action gesture.
